6\. Stalled checks can exceed the tool timeout 🐞 Bug ☼ Reliability 
ci_wait starts its nine-minute deadline only after authentication, origin, pull-request and rules
reads, each of which can consume a subprocess timeout, and it starts a further checks read without
bounding it by the remaining time. When those commands stall, one foreground call can run well
beyond the stated nine minutes and exceed the role's tool-call timeout before returning a wait or
error result.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The nine-minute limit excludes setup subprocesses and the final checks subprocess, so a stalled call can outlast its foreground tool timeout. ## Fix Focus Areas - src/hands/cli.py[217-257] - src/hands/forge.py[52-59] - src/hands/forge.py[90-95] ## Recommended Fix Start the deadline before setup and pass the remaining time as a timeout to every blocking subprocess, including the final poll. Return an appropriate waiting or error result when no time remains. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
